items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: He had a manager named Paul Jones, I think, was the guy that stood out in front and met everybody and congratulated it, but I don't know what you'd call him but a greeter

ctx.x: he went to San Diego and bought the Grant Hotel. Then from the Grant Hotel, he sold that, I think--I don't know what his business is--but anyway, he bought the Biltmore, and I think he died there a few years ago in the Biltmore. But he was a...uh...man in the background. He had a manager named Paul Jones, I think, was the guy that stood out in front and met everybody and congratulated it, but I don't know what you'd call him but a greeter, but he was so popular that he brought all the people there, you know.
